name: Pitch
summary: Auction bidding trick-taking game where high, low, jack and game points decide the winner.
rules_text: Use 52 cards ranking A high to 2 low. Deal 6 cards to each player, 3 at a time clockwise. In order left of dealer, each player bids 2-4 or passes; each bid must be higher than prior except dealer may take the current high bid. A bid of 4 is a smudge and cannot be outbid. Highest bidder is pitcher and leads to first trick; that suit is trump. Must follow trump if trump led, else may follow suit or trump; if unable to follow led suit may play any card. Highest trump wins trick, otherwise highest of led suit; winner leads next. After 6 tricks score 1 point each for High (highest trump played), Low (lowest trump played, owned by original holder), Jack (jack of trump), and Game (most total pip value in tricks, A=4, K=3, Q=2, J=1, 10=10). Non-pitchers keep points made. Pitcher keeps points if at least bid, else loses bid amount and may go negative (in the hole). First to +7 wins, pitcher counted first; tie among others broken High, Low, Jack, Game order. Smudge win of all 4 wins immediately unless pitcher was negative.
